{{Quote|I bet there's probably some mook fruit for you around here somewhere.|[[Tulkh]], to a tauntaun at the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy]]|<ref name="Red Harvest (novel)">[[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']]</ref>}}
'''Mook fruit''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that was enjoyed by [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntauns]]. In [[3645 BBY]], the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tulkh]] encountered a tauntaun in the stables of the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odacer-Faustin]], and he suggested that the creature would like some mook fruit.
